bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit holders, visitor vouchers or paid short-stay parking in marked bays
bays.times: Mon-Fri 8.30am-6.30pm. Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park event days: Monday to Friday 8.30am to 8.30pm; weekends and bank holidays midday to 6pm
bays.tariff: Hackney short-stay tariff Band 3 — per hour: zero-emissions vehicles £2.70; petrol registered from 2005 £3.85; diesel registered from 2015 £4.90; all other vehicles and pay-and-display machines £5.90
bays.pay: RingGo (app or website) or cash at a PayPoint shop — text 'Shop' plus the location number to 81025 for the nearest PayPoint; most of Hackney has no pay-and-display machines. One-hour minimum rate at all locations

bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone B1 in the Bow parent zone. A permit for any B zone is valid all day in every B zone
bays.tariff: Pay-and-display bays in this zone charge £5.50 per hour (£8.50 for diesel vehicles) — Zone B & D rate. Resident permits (12 months) by emissions band: Band 1 (100 g/km or less) £80; Band 2 (101–150 g/km) £150; Band 3 (151–185 g/km) £260; Band 4 (186 g/km or more) £690. Diesel surcharge £90 per year; second permit +£95, third permit +£260. Resident visitor voucher £3.90 per day (Tower Hamlets parking charges 2026/27)
bays.pay: Pay-and-display machine or an approved parking app (Tower Hamlets is part of the National Parking Platform)
